title: Integral of powers on the unit interval
statement:
For natural numbers $k$ and $m$, the integral of $x^k(1-x)^m$ over $[0,1]$ is
\[\int_0^1 x^k(1-x)^m\,dx=\frac{k!\,m!}{(k+m+1)!}.\]
